parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-23 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 994.7 | 15.91 | 15.91
2 | 1719.5 | 4.88 | 20.79
3 | 7929.4 | 21.88 | 42.67
4 | 8125.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-23
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: None identified (N/A)
Recommendation: Drilling is not recommended at this station due to excessively high resistivities across all layers, indicating dry overburden underlain by tight, unfractured bedrock with no viable aquifer. Relocate drilling to an alternative site showing lower resistivity targets associated with saturated weathering or fracturing.
